# raff_ssh_key (Resource)

Registers an SSH public key for use when creating Linux VMs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `public_key` (String) Full SSH public key string (e.g. "ssh-ed25519 AAAA... user@host").

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key_type` (String) Parsed algorithm (ed25519, rsa, etc.).
- `updated_at` (String)
